summary: Single-church parish with one stored bulletin (Sept. 27, 2026) that prints no schedule box. Sunday 8:00 AM and 9:30 AM Masses are weekly from the repeated intentions and lectors lists and the website. One grouped question asks about a Tue-Thu noon chapel Mass that only the website lists, as cancelled until further notice.
